message: Ready to buy today: T75 with 3-yr warranty for $68,000 total.

Thanks for being ready to move today. Our prices are fixed at list, so the T75 Row-Crop with the 3-year extended warranty comes to $70,400 total ($68,000 for the tractor plus $2,400 for the warranty). I can issue that offer now if it works for you.
Heartland Tractor Supply posts the same T75 at $65,950 and warranty at $2,325 ($68,275). Will you match so I can buy from you now?

I appreciate you sharing that, and I understand wanting the best price. Our pricing is fixed at list, though, so I'm not able to match other dealers. The T75 Row-Crop with the 3-year extended warranty is $70,400 total. That covers parts and labor for three years beyond the standard 1-year warranty, on a 75 hp 4WD tractor with an enclosed A/C cab. If it helps, we also offer delivery and setup within 150 miles at list price. My offer of $70,400 stands and I can issue it whenever you're ready.
